project.name: Gimle PKI
project.description: Certificate authority and CSR generation/signing for gimle.transport.protocol=tls, via Bouncy Castle -- confirmed to use only public JDK APIs underneath (java.security.Signature, KeyPairGenerator, BigInteger) plus its own ASN.1/DER encoder, unlike the sun.security.x509 internals route this design explicitly ruled out. Deliberately its own module, not gimle-core: only gimle-controlplane (signs CSRs at /bootstrap/csr) and gimle-agent (generates its own CSR at first bootstrap) ever call into it -- putting Bouncy Castle in gimle-core would have handed every other module a dependency on a substantial third-party crypto library none of them ever use.
